# Requirements Document: infrastructure/external/backtest_presenter_impl.py

## 1. Module Overview
Backtest Presenter Implementation - Humble Object for UI/visualization

This implementation provides presentation logic for backtest results,
following the Humble Object pattern to keep UI code testable.

## 2. Dependencies
- `__future__.annotations`
- `logging`
- `typing.Any`
- `typing.Dict`
- `typing.List`
- `typing.Optional`
- `application.interfaces.backtest_presenter.BacktestPresenter`
- `application.use_cases.analyze_backtest_results_use_case.AnalyzeBacktestResultsUseCase`
- `domain.entities.backtest.Backtest`
- `domain.repositories.backtest_repository.BacktestRepository`

## 3. Core Components (Contracts)
### Public Classes
- `BacktestPresenterImpl`: Must conform to application domain models.
### Public Functions
- `present_backtest_result()`: Must return strictly typed objects.
- `present_backtest_list()`: Must return strictly typed objects.
- `present_performance_summary()`: Must return strictly typed objects.
- `present_comparison()`: Must return strictly typed objects.
- `present_error()`: Must return strictly typed objects.

## 4. Execution Requirements (Compliance Rules)
- [x] Must execute without syntax errors.
- [x] Must contain explicit structured logging or print interception.
- [x] Must not expose external secrets.
- [ ] Exceptions must be handled.
